data.name: Hoshea
data.gender_notes: Hoshea is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Hoshea is recorded in name-lists as “Jehovah is Salvation”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Hoshea expresses “Jehovah is Salvation”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hoshea total 29, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.

in_hebrew.name: הושע
in_hebrew.meaning: ישועה הוא שמו, הושע פירושו ישועה או הצלה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: הושע הוא שם עברי שפירושו ישועה או הצלה. הוא מורכב משתי מילים: הושע ויהו, שפירושו הוא האל יהוה הוא ישועה. הושע היה גם שם של בן נושע, מלך ישראל האחרון, שנזכר בתנ"ך.

in_greek.name: Ωσηε
in_greek.meaning: σωτηρία ἐστιν ὁ ὄνομα, Ὡσηε σημαίνει σωτηρία
in_greek.long_meaning: Ὡσηε ἦν ὄνομα Ἑβραϊκόν, τὸ ὁποῖον σημαίνει σωτηρία ἤ救援. Ὁ προφήτης Ὡσηε ἦν ἕνας τῶν δώδεκα προφητών τῆς Παλαιάς Διαθήκης.

in_latin.name: Osee
in_latin.meaning: salus est nomen eius, Osee significat salvationem
in_latin.long_meaning: Osee nomen est Hebraeum, quod significat salus vel salvatio. Osee fuit etiam nomen prophetae, qui in Vetere Testamento commemoratur.
